official_title: Form 720: Quarterly Federal Excise Tax Return (including Q2 PCORI Fee IRS No. 133)

columns.format_notes: Legal entity name of employer/plan sponsor or excise taxpayer.
Optional DBA or trade name if different from legal name.
9-digit EIN formatted XX-XXXXXXX (synthetic 12-3456789 / 00-123456x in examples).

columns.pdf_field_example: Page1 Header: Number, Street, and Room or Suite No.
columns.format_notes: Taxpayer mailing street address.

columns.pdf_field_example: Page1 Header: City or Town, State, and ZIP Code
columns.format_notes: Preserve leading-zero ZIP codes (e.g., 07102) as text.
Quarter end date MM/DD/YYYY (06/30/YYYY for annual Q2 PCORI fee due July 31).
Yes/No indicator if this is a final Form 720 filing.
Yes/No indicator if taxpayer address changed since last filing.

columns.pdf_field_example: Part I / Part II Line Router (e.g., IRS No. 133 on Page 2)
columns.format_notes: IRS excise line number (e.g., 133 for PCORI self-insured health plans, 22 for communications).
Human-readable description used for CPA review and batch routing.

columns.pdf_field_example: Part II IRS No. 133 Column (a) Avg. number of lives covered
columns.format_notes: Average covered lives for PCORI (IRS No. 133) or taxable units/gallons for Part I excise lines.

columns.pdf_field_example: Part II IRS No. 133 Column (b) Rate
columns.format_notes: Tax rate per covered life/unit. Always verify current-year IRS PCORI / excise rates from official Form 720 instructions.
Total tax from Part I (0.00 for PCORI-only Q2 returns).
Total tax from Part II (equals Avg_Covered_Lives * Applicable_Rate for PCORI-only returns).
Sum of Part I Line 1 and Part II Line 2.
Allowable Schedule C claims (typically 0.00 for PCORI).
Excise tax deposits made for the quarter.
Net balance due carried to Form 720-V payment voucher if applicable.
Optional designee name (commonly fixed to CPA/benefits partner across batch).
Preparer Tax Identification Number (synthetic P00000001 in examples).
